requirements: R1: Prevent tasks from being marked as 'done' when their associated GitHub PRs are closed without being merged

slices.title: Patch task synchronization to check PR merge state
slices.jtbd: When implementing the GitHub PR sync patch for this epic, I want to check the PR's 'merged' boolean flag alongside its 'closed' state, so that the internal task accurately reflects the true resolution on GitHub without falsely marking it done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a system task linked to a GitHub PR
When the PR is closed but the 'merged' flag is false
Then the system must not update the task status to done
Given a test simulating a closed unmerged PR
When the PR sync logic processes it
Then the sync logic must reject task completion and remain in active state
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive task completions from >0% to 0%
